scope: Public zero-parameter by-value untyped constructors on ordinary unit0 parentless anonymous classes, including simple global function/static no-capture Closure factories. Defaults precede body effects; automatic allocation ignores return values, explicit calls observe them, and repeated shared Throwable/finally unwind preserves caller assignment and escaped receivers. Partial core; wider constructor/context/lifecycle interactions remain required.

        public function __construct() {
            echo 'C' . (++$GLOBALS['calls']) . ':' . $this->value . '|';
            $this->value = $GLOBALS['calls'];
            $this->scope = self::class;
            return 99;
        }
    };
    $objects[] = $object;
}
$first = $objects[0];
$second = $objects[1];
$class = $first::class;
$expected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':5$0';

echo 'exact:', $class === $expected ? 'yes' : 'BAD', '|';

<?php

function make() {
    return new class {
        public $value = 0;
        public function __construct() {
            global $calls;
            ++$calls;
            $this->value = $calls;
            echo 'F', $calls, '|';

}

    return new class {
        public $value = 0;
        function __CONSTRUCT() {

            $this->value = $calls;
            echo 'C', $calls, '|';
        }

$beforeName = 'class@anonymous' . "\0" . __FILE__ . ':4$0';

$second = $factory();

echo $returned === 99 ? 'return|' : 'BAD|';

<?php
$shared = new Exception('shared');
$escaped = null;
$calls = 0;
$last = 0;
function make() {
    return new class {
        public $value = 0;
        public function __construct() {
            global $shared, $escaped, $calls, $last;
            ++$calls;
            if ($calls === 1) { $escaped = $this; }
            try {
                $this->value = $calls;
                echo 'C', $calls, '|';
                throw $shared;
            } finally {
                $this->value = $this->value + 10;
                $last = $this->value;
                echo 'F', $calls, '|';
            }
        }
    };
}
$assigned = 'kept';
try { $assigned = make(); }
catch (Throwable $caught) { echo $caught === $shared ? 'same|' : 'BAD|'; }
$first = $escaped;
try { $assigned = make(); }
catch (Throwable $caught) { echo $caught === $shared ? 'same|' : 'BAD|'; }
echo $first === $escaped ? 'kept|' : 'BAD|';
echo 'assigned:', $assigned, '|values:', $first->value, ':', $last, '|calls:', $calls;
